pairs.old: A 99213 (brief office visit) is worth about 1.3 RVUs → ~$43. A 99214 (moderate office visit) is 1.92 RVUs → ~$63. A knee arthroscopy is 10+ RVUs → $340+. A primary care physician seeing 20 patients per day at 1–2 RVUs each earns less than a surgeon doing three procedures.
pairs.new: A 99213 office visit carries 1.30 work RVUs and a 99214 carries 1.92 (2021 values); the payment uses total RVUs (work plus practice expense plus malpractice), so the work RVU alone understates it. The bias shows up per hour: Sinsky and Dugdale (JAMA Internal Medicine, 2013) found Medicare paid 368% (screening colonoscopy) and 486% (cataract extraction) of the hourly revenue for the same physician time spent on evaluation and management.
